name: Diploma Food Technology
title: Diploma in Food Technology
intro: The food technology diploma roadmap: admission, food processing and quality subjects, plant training and jobs.

phases.title: Eligibility
phases.summary: Class 10 pass with Science for the 3-year diploma, or Class 12 Science for shorter courses.
points: Most polytechnics admit after Class 10 with Maths and Science.
Some institutes offer shorter diplomas after Class 12 Science.
Interest in food, chemistry and biology helps.
Check the recognition of the institute.

phases.title: Admission process
points: Apply on the state DTE portal or the institute website.
Counselling allots seats by merit.
Compare labs, pilot plants and placements.
Complete document verification and fee payment.

phases.title: Core subjects
phases.summary: Food chemistry, processing, preservation and quality.
points: Study Food Chemistry, Food Microbiology, Food Processing and Preservation, and Nutrition.
Learn Dairy, Bakery, Fruits and Vegetables, Cereals and Beverage technology.
Study Food Packaging, Food Laws (FSSAI) and Quality Control.
Complete lab practicals and a final project.

phases.title: Industrial training
phases.summary: Training in food plants and labs.
points: Train in a dairy, bakery, beverage or food processing plant.
Learn HACCP, GMP and hygiene practices.
Operate processing equipment and test samples.
Maintain a training record.

phases.title: Jobs and upgrade
phases.summary: Food industry roles or a degree.
points: Roles: food technician, quality control assistant, production supervisor and lab analyst.
Employers: dairies, packaged food firms, bakeries and FSSAI-licensed labs.
Upgrade: lateral entry into B.Tech Food Technology.
Start-up options include food processing units and cloud kitchens.
